mentions.name: AthenaOS
mentions.description: This open-source project is an AI-agent-based personal investing platform with dashboards for the user's portfolio, additional investing-specific tools, and an AI-human collaboration for researching economics via a community tab. All data models are stored in markdown and Excel so there is no lock-in, allowing manual editing of positions and agent personalities. It is released as open source to address the frustration that most investing tools scrape personal data and force subscription lock-in.
mentions.problem: Most investing tools scrape personal data and force users into subscription lock-in; this project aims to be an open, no-lock-in alternative with editable data models.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building AthenaOS: https://athena-os.ai/

Basically OpenClaw but with investing dashboards for my portfolio, additional tools specifically for investing, and exploring an AI-Human collaboration on researching economics (check the 'community' tab).

The data models are all in markdown and Excel so that there's no lockin and you can manually edit positions, personalities, etc.
